## A Future at Risk: Global Patterns in Adolescent Health and School Infrastructure

This report visualizes how the lack of school infrastructure, such as clean drinking water, may intersect with high adolescent health risks, particularly AIDS-related deaths among girls. In many low-income countries, both education and health are under stress. Investment in one area (like safe schools) may indirectly influence the other.

Using data from UNICEF, we identify countries with poor water access in schools and high AIDS death rates, helping to highlight where international attention is most urgently needed.

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false

import pandas as pd

# Load the UNICEF datasets
meta = pd.read_csv("unicef_metadata.csv")
ind1 = pd.read_csv("unicef_indicator_1.csv")
ind2 = pd.read_csv("unicef_indicator_2.csv")

# Preview data
meta.head()

# Clean and prepare AIDS data
aids = ind1.copy()
aids = aids[aids['sex'] == 'Female']
aids_latest = aids.sort_values('time_period').groupby('country', as_index=False).last()
aids_latest = aids_latest[['country', 'obs_value']].rename(columns={'obs_value': 'aids_death_rate'})

# Clean and prepare Water Access data
water = ind2.copy()
water_latest = water.sort_values('time_period').groupby('country', as_index=False).last()
water_latest = water_latest[['country', 'obs_value']].rename(columns={'obs_value': 'water_access_pct'})

# Merge both datasets on 'country'
combined = pd.merge(aids_latest, water_latest, on='country')

# Convert to numeric just in case
combined['aids_death_rate'] = pd.to_numeric(combined['aids_death_rate'], errors='coerce')
combined['water_access_pct'] = pd.to_numeric(combined['water_access_pct'], errors='coerce')

# Drop rows with missing values
combined.dropna(inplace=True)

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from plotnine import *

# Create scatterplot with regression line
plot = (ggplot(combined, aes(x='water_access_pct', y='aids_death_rate')) +
        geom_point() +
        geom_smooth(method='lm', se=False, color='blue') +
        labs(title='Water Access vs AIDS Death Rate',
             x='Water Access in Schools (%)',
             y='AIDS-Related Death Rate (per 100,000)') +
        theme_minimal())

plot
```
```{python}
from plotnine import *

# Prepare data
bar_data = water_latest.copy()
bar_data['water_access_pct'] = pd.to_numeric(bar_data['water_access_pct'], errors='coerce')
bar_data = bar_data.dropna().sort_values('water_access_pct').head(15)

# Plot
(
    ggplot(bar_data, aes(x='reorder(country, water_access_pct)', y='water_access_pct')) +
    geom_bar(stat='identity', fill='#4682B4') +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title='Bottom 15 Countries for Water Access',
         x='Country',
         y='Water Access in Schools (%)')
)
```

```{python}
sample_countries = ['Uganda', 'Ethiopia', 'Haiti', 'Botswana', 'South Africa']
aids_sample = ind1[ind1['country'].isin(sample_countries)]
aids_sample['obs_value'] = pd.to_numeric(aids_sample['obs_value'], errors='coerce')
aids_sample['time_period'] = pd.to_numeric(aids_sample['time_period'], errors='coerce')

# Plot
(
    ggplot(aids_sample, aes(x='time_period', y='obs_value', color='country')) +
    geom_line() +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title='AIDS Death Rate Over Time (By Country)',
         x='Year',
         y='AIDS Death Rate (per 100,000)')
)
```

```{python}
import geopandas as gpd
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load shapefile
world = gpd.read_file("data/ne_110m_admin_0_countries.shp")

# Prepare water data
water_map = water_latest.rename(columns={'country': 'ADMIN'})
water_map['water_access_pct'] = pd.to_numeric(water_map['water_access_pct'], errors='coerce')

# Merge shapefile with water data
world_map = world.merge(water_map, on='ADMIN', how='left')

# Plot
world_map.plot(
    column='water_access_pct',
    cmap='Blues',
    legend=True,
    figsize=(15, 8),
    edgecolor='black',
    missing_kwds={"color": "lightgrey", "label": "No data"}
)

plt.show()
```
